contract.deliverable: Add a `--fail-fast` flag to the `run` command that stops at the first failed step and exits non-zero
acceptance: `run --fail-fast` stops after the first failing step
`run` without the flag still runs every step
constraints: Allowed files: src/cli.ts, src/runner.ts and cli.test.ts

managerSetup: sync a cpm plan with this deliverable and pin owned_files for cli.ts, runner.ts and cli.test.ts
expected.rationale: The change spans two source files plus tests, so an explicit plan with owned files prevents overlapping edits
